# Solana Balances API

> Solana balances API: fetch SPL & Token-2022 holdings with Vybe balances and metadata, and live USD portfolio values for any Solana wallet.

This is a free demo that showcases the Vybe balance endpoints. Open it in the browser to test and demo them. Nothing to install. The linked docs pages are the Markdown versions.

## What this demo shows
Enter a wallet and the page lists its SPL and Token-2022 holdings, with symbol, logo, and USD value on each row. Switch the table to PnL and it loads that wallet's profit and loss plus one related top-trader row.

- Holdings: SPL and Token-2022 balances for the wallet, sorted by USD value.
- USD value: each row carries the holding's USD value from the balance response.
- Token metadata: symbol, name, and logo filled in for the mints in that wallet.
- PnL view: realized profit and loss for the wallet, plus a related trader row.

## Endpoints this demo calls
- Wallet Balances API: `GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/token-balance`
- Token Details API: `GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}`
- Trader PnL API: `GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/pnl`
- Top Traders API: `GET /v4/wallets/top-traders`
- DeFi Positions API: `GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/defi-positions`

The demo page is free to use. Wallet Balances is on the Free plan, the lowest tier. A free API key starts the first calls. Paid plans raise the rate limit.

## Demo
- [Solana Balances API](https://solana-balances-api.vybenetwork.com/): Free browser demo of the balance endpoints. Enter a wallet to test holdings and USD value.
